capabilities: Chat with Infomaniak Euria models in a sidebar with tabs, history and streaming
Read, search, create, append and overwrite notes via function-calling tools with confirmation and diff preview
Extract text from PDF, DOCX and PPTX files in the vault
Run optional web search through DuckDuckGo or the Brave Search API
Edit selected text inline with AI and review a word diff before accepting
extras: Desktop-only. Infomaniak offers a free tier, but usage beyond it is billed by Infomaniak; the plugin itself is free. There is no delete tool for the vault agent, and overwrite replaces a note's entire content. The API key is stored in plain text in data.json.
intentEvidence: Both plugins share the same core; Euridian used to include those backends up to version 0.3.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, and users who want the Swiss GDPR-compliant Infomaniak Euria service have no plugin connecting to it.
